shots.line: This video built itself. Watch the machine that made it.
shots.scene: machine room wide at dusk: the machine runs on its own, hero walks in, title card pops

shots.line: Step one, research. Real sources, spoken by the researcher agent.
shots.scene: desk medium: hero skims paper stack by the window, SOURCES badge

shots.line: Step two, the script. Short, punchy, timed to the exact word.
shots.scene: insert: script page macro, typed lines draw in one by one, TIMED badge

shots.line: Step three, the voice. A local model speaks it, right now.
shots.scene: bigFace hero close-up, sound rings on the word VOICE, warm rim

shots.line: Step four, the storyboard. One master timeline hands every frame its job.
shots.scene: blueprint: shot cells pop onto a master timeline spine, one by one

shots.line: The picture engine paints the frames, thirty every second.
The editing engine adds captions, overlays, and the final mix.
shots.scene: console medium: EDITOR at the monitor with caption bars, HERO watches over the shoulder
shots.notes: first shot of seg3 - must cut in

shots.line: Loudness checked, safe zones clear, one file ready to upload.
shots.scene: blueprint QC: loudness meter fills to -14, SAFE ring with check, READY badge

shots.line: That is the factory. One folder, zero cameras, every week.
shots.scene: rooftop wide at dusk: hero and the machine side by side at the railing, skyline, slow pull-out; endCard dims in (Remotion)
